competency_fulfillment.rationale: Sixteen of eighteen samples state the requirement directly, e.g. '75 is 7 tens and 5 ones. 12 is 1 ten and 2 ones.', but the two read_mcq items reduce the stem to the bare 'How many items are left?' with no minuend or subtrahend expressed as tens and ones in the text.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The packet covers subtracting a bare ones-value subtrahend, '15 is 1 ten and 5 ones. 4 is 4 ones.', subtracting an even decade, '13 is 1 ten and 3 ones. 10 is 1 ten and 0 ones.', and subtracting zero, '26 is 2 tens and 6 ones. 0 is 0 ones.', so the sub-cases implied by 'minuends and subtrahends as tens and ones' are not limited to the easiest pairing.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Every direct-computation stem walks the student through the reasoning in two short sentences before asking the question, e.g. '45 is 4 tens and 5 ones. 40 is 4 tens and 0 ones. Subtract the place values, then find what's left: 45 − 40 = ___', matching a grade 1 quarter 3 first pass at expanded-form subtraction.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The eighteen samples span direct computation (formatter mcq), a fill-in blank (formatter cloze), part-part-whole phrasing ('The total is 60 and one part is 20. What is the other part?'), and error-checking framing ('Ana says: 33 is 3 tens and 3 ones.' before asking 'Is Ana correct?'), well beyond a single task type.

competency_alignment.rationale: In every cited pair the ones digit of the minuend is at least the ones digit of the subtrahend, for instance '88 is 8 tens and 8 ones. 58 is 5 tens and 8 ones.', so difficulty stays inside the competency's own 'without regrouping' boundary rather than drifting to an unrelated axis.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Every explicit minuend/subtrahend pair stays within two digits, up to '94 is 9 tens and 4 ones. 72 is 7 tens and 2 ones.', yet seed 500's own option set includes the value 152, a three-digit number inconsistent with the two-digit tens/ones ceiling every other sample respects.
